All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
CanonicalHashes
SHA-256 digests in the TRACE sha256:<64 lowercase hex> format over raw bytes or over the JCS canonical form of a JSON value.
Ed25519Capability
Startup probe for Ed25519 support in the installed BouncyCastle provider.
Ed25519PublicKeys
Builds Ed25519 PublicKeys from RFC 8037 OKP JWKs ({"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"<32 raw bytes, base64url>"}) through the JCA KeyFactory of the installed BouncyCastle provider (standard or FIPS), so no BC-internal class is referenced.
Ed25519Verifier
Verifies Ed25519 (RFC 8032, PureEdDSA, no pre-hash, no context) signatures with the JCA Signature of the installed BouncyCastle provider.
JavaTraceCryptoProvider
TraceCryptoProviderType.JAVA implementation of TraceCryptoProvider: in-house RFC 8785 JCS, Ed25519 through the installed BouncyCastle JCA provider, JDK SHA-256.
JcsCanonicalizer
In-house, dependency-free implementation of RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme, JCS) over Jackson JsonNode trees.
JcsException
Thrown when a JSON value cannot be canonicalized according to RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme): non-finite numbers, lone UTF-16 surrogates in strings or property names, and Jackson node types that have no JSON representation (POJO, binary, missing).
